name: analog-lead-into-braam
style: 120 BPM, instrumental, 1980s film-score synths, 2010s revival, analog synthesizers, drum machine. Opening four seconds bright and wistful: lone mono saw lead, wide chorus, slight glide, bittersweet heroic melody; pulsing 16th-note analog bass; warm detuned polysynth pads; LinnDrum groove with gated-reverb snare. At 4 seconds lead and drums stop dead on one enormous low synth-brass braam. Then dark and dry: ticking low-string and sub-bass ostinato locked to the same 120 pulse, one metallic impact on every beat, growing heavier and grimmer. Final bars: tape-stop, pitch and speed sag to silence
exclude: EDM drop, trap, autotune, big pop chorus, vocals, choir, singing, spoken word, dubstep wobble, guitar solo, fade-in
